preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer t (1 ≤ t ≤ 20000), representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(n.is_integer() and 2 <= n <= 300000 for n in (int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2]))
preconditions.description: For each test case, the first line is an integer n (2 ≤ n ≤ 300000), representing the number of piranhas.

preconditions.expression: all(len(a) == n and all(a_i.is_integer() and 1 <= a_i <= 10**9 for a_i in a) for n, a in zip((int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2]), (list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines()[2::2])))
preconditions.description: For each test case, the second line contains n integers a_1, a_2, ..., a_n (1 ≤ a_i ≤ 10^9), representing the sizes of the piranhas.
The sum of n across all test cases does not exceed 300000.

postconditions.expression: all((output_line == '-1' or (output_line.is_integer() and 1 <= int(output_line) <= n)) for output_line, n in zip(stdout.splitlines(), (int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2])))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is either -1 (no dominant piranha) or an integer i (1 ≤ i ≤ n) representing the index of a dominant piranha.

postconditions.expression: all((output_line == '-1' or (any((a[i-1] > 0 and all(a[j-1] < a[i-1] + (j-1 == i-1) for j in range(1, n+1) if j != i)) for i in range(1, n+1)) if output_line != '-1' else True)) for output_line, a, n in zip(stdout.splitlines(), (list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines()[2::2]), (int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2])))
postconditions.description: If the output is an index i, then the piranha at position i can eat all other piranhas in the aquarium. This means that starting from the initial configuration, the piranha at position i can sequentially eat all other piranhas by always eating an adjacent piranha smaller than itself, with its size increasing by 1 after each successful eat.
